Among the OSA candidates, PGS005220 reports the strongest visible discrimination evidence without relying on an obviously covariate-inflated metric: full-model AUROC=0.79 plus a substantial per-SD OR=1.53 (95% CI 1.39–1.68), with multi-cohort development (FinnGen, MGBB, MVP) and multi-ancestry evaluation noted; by contrast, the ExPRSweb sleep-apnea scores show near-chance AUROC (~0.49–0.53) and small effect sizes.
